hero.headline: Two growth engines:
hero.description1: We invested $1,200 in test advertising. Result: 47 quality leads (~$25/lead) and 23+ came organically through word of mouth.
hero.description2: Both engines work. The market is ready for us.

problem.title: Why do we see what others cannot?
problem.subTitle: We built the product for ourselves.
problem.description: We are not just a SaaS startup. We are a team that combines deep technology expertise with hands-on experience managing our own auto service network. MECHorbit was born from our daily pain. We know what works and what doesn't — because we tested it on our own business.

cards.title: First-hand experience
cards.description: We are our own customers. We felt the pain of running a "paper-based" business ourselves and created the cure for it.

cards.title: Deep expertise
cards.description: We understand the inner workings of an auto service down to the smallest details, inaccessible to outside software developers.

cards.title: Battle-tested
cards.description: Every feature of MECHorbit went through real-world testing in our own network before reaching customers.

math.title: 50% of auto services still run on notebooks and Excel
math.description: This is not an assumption. This is data from our first 70+ organic leads. The market is technologically stuck in the last century.

cards.title: Total chaos
cards.description: The lack of systematic accounting turns the business into chaos, where it is impossible to plan workload and control resources.

cards.title: Loss of up to 30% of profit
cards.description: Process inefficiencies, lost customers and "missing" spare parts cost services a third of their potential revenue.

cards.title: Absolute distrust
cards.description: The end consumer — the car owner — does not trust a "garage" approach without a transparent history and digital reports.

info.title: We start with the customer,
info.titleSpan: to "connect" the entire auto service market for free.
info.description: Our B2C2B strategy launches a self-reinforcing cycle that allows us to capture the market with minimal costs, using the car owner as a "Trojan horse".

cards.title: Car owner acquisition
cards.description: Car owners download a free app — a "digital service book". We deliver value to drivers.

cards.title: Connection
cards.description: We connect them to the service, transferring the full car history and a ready checklist of required work.

cards.title: Auto service "capture"
cards.description: We give them free access to our CRM to process the "hot" client, integrating them into the ecosystem.

cards.title: Monetization
cards.description: We offer auto services premium plans with indispensable tools they will not be able to give up.

price.title: Proven result:
price.conclusionText: 10% of all leads came from Europe, proving global demand and the x3 pricing potential.

data.title: Our real product is
data.description: MECH is not just a SaaS. It is the future Data Engine for the entire Aftermarket. Aggregated data from millions of "digital cars" will become the company's most valuable asset.
